description: This file defines the interface InputManagerCompat for handling input device events, including device info retrieval and listener registration. It also includes a Factory class to instantiate platform-specific implementations based on Android SDK version.

classes.name: InputManagerCompat
classes.description: An interface providing methods for input device management and event handling.

classes.name: InputManagerCompat.Factory
classes.description: A factory class to create platform-specific implementations of InputManagerCompat.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.description: Retrieves information about an input device by its ID.

methods.name: getInputDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns an array of all input device IDs in the system.

methods.name: registerInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to receive notifications about input device add/remove/change events.

methods.name: unregisterInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered input device listener.

methods.name: onGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Passes motion events to the input manager for processing.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Signals the input manager to stop polling for device changes.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Signals the input manager to start polling for device changes.

methods.name: getInputManager
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate platform-specific InputManager implementation.
